proof_summary: Inductively stripping off least prime factors shows that any $m<2\cdot2^{v_2(\phi(m))}$ is a squarefree product of Fermat primes $F_j$, with $v_2(\phi(m))=\sum_j2^j$. For a candidate below $2^{2^{33}+1}$, the divisibility and size bounds force this valuation to be $2^{33}$, whose unique sum of distinct powers of two selects only $F_{33}$; the explicit candidates $F_{33}$ when prime and $2^{2^{33}+1}$ otherwise then establish minimality.
